mapper.update: UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT user_id, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS count_fenlei_1, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS count_fenlei_2, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS count_fenlei_3, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS count_fenlei_4 FROM sci_zhuanliruanzhu WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY user_id ) b ON a.userId = b.user_id SET a.sqfmzl = COALESCE(b.count_fenlei_1, 0), a.syxxzl = COALESCE(b.count_fenlei_2, 0), a.wxsjzl = COALESCE(b.count_fenlei_3, 0), a.jsjrjzzq = COALESCE(b.count_fenlei_4, 0)
